title: Public holiday closure affecting TTF Natural Gas
description: TTF Natural Gas will be closed for a national public holiday. Settlement and clearing activities scheduled for that date will move to the next business day.

title: REMIT reporting reminder for UKA Carbon Emissions participants
description: Participants active on UKA Carbon Emissions are reminded of their inside-information disclosure obligations and encouraged to review their reporting configuration ahead of the winter contracts.

title: Historical-data availability for PEG Natural Gas
description: Extended historical order-book data for PEG Natural Gas is now available via the bulk history endpoint to support back-testing and analytics.

title: Clearing house margin update for EEX German Power
description: Following a volatility review, initial-margin parameters for EEX German Power cleared products will be adjusted. Members should ensure sufficient collateral ahead of the effective date.

title: New contract listed for OMIE Iberian Power
description: A new forward contract has been listed on OMIE Iberian Power with standard lot and tick-size conventions. Trading opens at the next session and the instrument is immediately eligible for clearing.

title: Amended trading hours for Nord Pool Nordic Power
description: Trading hours for Nord Pool Nordic Power will be extended by thirty minutes ahead of the seasonal contract roll to accommodate expected higher volumes around the close.

title: Fee-schedule update for Zeebrugge Natural Gas
description: An updated fee schedule for Zeebrugge Natural Gas takes effect next quarter. The revised maker-taker structure is intended to encourage resting liquidity.

title: Position-limit review for EPEX French Power
description: The venue has completed its periodic position-limit review for EPEX French Power; revised limits and accountability levels are set out in the accompanying document.

title: Waiver of listing fees for new UKA Carbon Emissions contracts
description: Listing fees for newly introduced UKA Carbon Emissions contracts will be waived for an introductory period to encourage participation.

title: Delivery-period revision for UKA Carbon Emissions
description: Delivery-period definitions for certain UKA Carbon Emissions seasonal contracts have been revised to align with the updated market calendar.

title: MiFID II transaction-reporting guidance for UKA Carbon Emissions
description: Updated guidance clarifies reporting fields for UKA Carbon Emissions instruments, including flags for algorithmic and direct-electronic-access activity.

title: Market-data schema upgrade for TTF Natural Gas
description: The market-data feed for TTF Natural Gas will migrate to a new versioned schema. A parallel run is available for testing and the legacy feed will be retired after the transition window.

title: Launch of a new EUA Carbon Emissions order book
description: A new order book for EUA Carbon Emissions will launch, offering additional delivery periods. Market-making commitments are in place to support initial liquidity.

title: Volatility interruption rules on Zeebrugge Natural Gas
description: Updated volatility-interruption thresholds for Zeebrugge Natural Gas will apply, defining the price bands that trigger a short auction to restore orderly trading.

title: Latency-statistics publication for N2EX UK Power
description: N2EX UK Power will begin publishing anonymised latency statistics to improve transparency around execution performance.

title: Planned maintenance affecting PEG Natural Gas
description: A scheduled maintenance window will briefly affect PEG Natural Gas connectivity outside trading hours. Sessions should reconnect automatically once the window closes.

title: Expiry and settlement for EUA Carbon Emissions front contract
description: The front contract on EUA Carbon Emissions will expire at the end of the session. Final settlement prices will be published according to the standard methodology.

title: Tick-size change on Nord Pool Nordic Power
description: The minimum price increment for selected Nord Pool Nordic Power contracts will be reduced to improve price granularity. Connected clients should confirm their systems support the finer tick.

title: Clearing house holiday for Nord Pool Nordic Power products
description: The clearing house observing a holiday will delay margin processing for Nord Pool Nordic Power products by one business day; trading remains unaffected.

title: New co-location cross-connect option for Zeebrugge Natural Gas
description: A lower-latency cross-connect option is now available for Zeebrugge Natural Gas co-located clients. Onboarding details are provided in the technical pack.
